title: OVERRIDE: Repo neutral daemon identities and runtime
summary: SPEC IS INCOMPLETE: the daemon has no current or attached project. Every graph operation carries graph_repo; every Git operation carries target_repo or uses a persisted task target; workspace_id is a named registry group. Deprecated workspace and repo_path aliases remain migration-only. Single-repo convenience is composed only at the MCP/client boundary, never by the daemon. Linked worktrees resolve through Git commondir to the primary graph repo even when .graph is tracked. Daemon-owned runtime state lives in the OS application-data directory; upgrade migration is copy-first, daemon-start/CLI-init only, resumable, non-overwriting, skips legacy worktrees, and preserves the legacy source.
